name: Defer non-essential features behind flags
description: Several features added in the past 3 days are 'nice to have' but not essential for core autonomous operation: telemetry events, council suggestions, model recommendations display. Defer these behind opt-in flags so core loop is simpler.

userStories.title: Make telemetry opt-in with FADE_TELEMETRY flag
userStories.description: events.jsonl logging adds I/O overhead. Make it opt-in.
acceptanceCriteria: FADE_TELEMETRY=1 enables event logging to events.jsonl

userStories.title: Remove automatic council suggestions from loop
userStories.description: Council suggestions interrupt flow. User can run `fade council` manually.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove display_council_suggestion() calls from cmd_run loop
fade council command still works for manual use
No prompts or suggestions interrupt the execution loop

userStories.title: Remove model recommendation display from loop
userStories.description: Model recommendation banner adds noise. Routing happens silently.
acceptanceCriteria: Model selection still works (just no banner)
fade run --show-recommendation still works for manual check
Reduces output noise during autonomous operation

technicalNotes.rationale: Simple conditional removals and flag checks. Haiku sufficient.
